# winmine.exe is all Rust (winmine-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/winmine-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/winmine-rust/src/winmine/main.rs)
# dialog.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/winmine-rust/src/winmine/dialog.rs)
add_cargo_module(winmine winmine-cargo winmine.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE winmine-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
